title: Stabilized Higher-Order Influence Functions: Statistical Theory of a Class of Bilinear Forms
abstract: arXiv:2607.04743v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Higher-order influence functions, introduced in a series of articles (Robins et al., 2008, 2009a; van der Vaart, 2014; Robins et al., 2016, 2023; Liu et al., 2017), are a unified framework for constructing rate-optimal point estimates of a class of statistical functionals under various complexity-reducing assumptions on the posited statistical model that generates the observed data. Although higher-order (influence functions) estimators are theoretically appealing, they have very limited practical uptake compared to their first-order counterparts. The original higher-order estimators proposed in Robins et al. (2008) and Robins et al. (2017) involve nonparametric density estimation of multi-dimensional covariates, a highly nontrivial statistical and computational problem on its own. The density estimator is, in turn, used in the evaluation of the inverse population Gram matrix $\Omega$ of a set of $k$-dimensional basis transform

translated_title: 稳定化的高阶影响函数：一类双线性形式的统计理论
translated_abstract: 高阶影响函数由一系列文章（Robins等人，2008、2009a；van der Vaart，2014；Robins等人，2016、2023；Liu等人，2017）引入，是一个统一框架，用于在关于生成观测数据的假定统计模型的各种降低复杂性假设下，为一类统计泛函构造达到最优收敛速率的点估计。尽管高阶（影响函数）估计量在理论上很有吸引力，但与一阶对应方法相比，它们在实际应用中的采用非常有限。Robins等人（2008）和Robins等人（2017）提出的原始高阶估计量涉及多维协变量的非参数密度估计，这本身就是一个非常不平凡的统计和计算问题。密度估计器进而被用于评估一组k维基变换的总体Gram矩阵 $\Omega$ 的逆……
tldr: 该论文提出稳定化的高阶影响函数，通过建立一类双线性形式的统计理论，克服了传统高阶估计量中多维协变量非参数密度估计带来的统计与计算困难，推动高阶影响函数方法的实际应用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes stabilized higher-order influence functions through the statistical theory of a class of bilinear forms, overcoming the statistical and computational difficulties of nonparametric density estimation of multi-dimensional covariates in traditional higher-order estimators, thereby promoting the practical adoption of higher-order influence function methods.
